notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Added character interactions to dog, owl, and cat.
-Fixed a few small but crucial bugs in different modes.

notes.title: Power-Up timers
notes.content:
Added power-up timers for leaf and feather.
Power-up duration is now refreshed to 30 sec, not limited to 30 secs.

notes.title: Tiny patch to put cat back into original mode.
notes.content: Cat was missing from original mode.

notes.title: Original Mode
notes.content: Added sort of new/old mode, just giving the option of playing the original version of the game with no pesky dog or owl to impede your nut collecting, score building fun :)

notes.title: Minor interface changes
notes.content:
- all scroll boxes are navigable with a gamepad.
- high score and rank are on game screen in progressive mode.
- other minor navigation changes.

notes.title: Minor interface change
notes.content: added global rank and score to game screen.

notes.title: Changed graphics settings.
notes.content: Changed graphics settings.  Removed Low graphics setting and added cinematic, which for this game really just runs your graphics card harder than needed with no to very little visual quality gain.
